platform: iOS opt-in host candidate; unregistered and not Apple-compiled

tryAcquire.semantics: fixed host owner; one global OS/process lock; same acquisition can recover its token; busy means no granted token

load.semantics: matching engine, scope and current token required

compareAndSet.semantics: Exact UTF-8 expected-value match; Keychain item replacement plus exact readback. An error may follow a committed update; never reset or assume absence.

release.semantics: original acquisition key releases only its own live lock; no record deletion

writeUnknown: An error after a write may mean it committed. Preserve the original recovery operation; do not infer absence or reset the store.

storage.installationAnchor: fixed app-private no-backup file; identifier bound inside item
